creator: Alexander Terp
description:
herdr writes at most one event of each subscribed kind per 100ms pass of its subscription loop, so a busy kind lags. Measured 2026-09-12 against the pinned daemon, and read from v0.8.0 `src/api/server.rs` (`stream_subscriptions`, `CONNECTION_POLL_INTERVAL`). `docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md`, "Subscribing replays recent events, one kind at a time", has the table.

A burst of title changes or agent detections therefore arrives seconds late, and order across kinds is lost. Muster's mirror now tolerates the lost order (`7394a5b`). The lag remains, and it reaches the agent states the sidebar shows.

Worth raising upstream, and worth checking what in Muster reads a busy kind and would be seconds stale under load.
title: 🔌 Upstream: herdr delivers ten events of each kind a second
